resources.string: Your phone stays silent while you\'re using it, and your ringer comes back when you put it down.
Turn on to silence the phone whenever you\'re using it.
Android only lets apps switch to silent mode after you allow Do Not Disturb access. Find this app in the list and turn it on.
Swipe down twice from the top, tap the edit (pencil) icon, and drag the \"SilentWhenUse\" tile into your toggles, just like the torch.
